text: UK UZTM-Kartex, the company whose main shareholder was Gazprombank from 2016 and which manages the UZTM-Kartex group including Uralmashzavod, was sold in majority on 16 March 2022: 51% passed to JSC Enlil Finance and 48.6% is held by the closed mutual fund 'Gazprombank - industrial investments'.
short: 51% of Uralmashzavod's holding company went to JSC Enlil Finance in March 2022.

source.name: Коммерсантъ-Урал: Уралмашзавод направит 95% чистой прибыли на погашение убытков прошлых лет
source.note: Translation of quote: 'On 16 March 2022, 51% of UZTM-Kartex passed to JSC Enlil Finance; a further 48.6% belongs to ZPIF Gazprombank - industrial investments.' Enlil Finance's own shareholders are not public.
source.quote: 16 марта 2022 года 51% УЗТМ-Картэкс перешли АО «Энлиль Файненс», еще 48,6% принадлежат ЗПИФ «Газпромбанк - промышленные инвестиции».
